d:
Welcome to Episode 1 of our 4-part documentary series on Pitrapaksh Mela, jo har saal Gaya Ji, Bihar mein hota hai. Pitrapaksh ka main purpose hota hai Pind Daan aur Shraddha rituals ke through pitraon ko Moksha dilana.
Documentary produced by Fork Media Group in association with Bihar Tourism.
Gaya Ji ko Moksha Bhoomi mana jata hai, aur Pitrapaksh ke dauran yahan lakhon log aakar Pind Daan apne purvajo ke liye perform karte hain.
This 4-part series explores:
Pind Daan in Gaya
Pitrapaksh Mela significance
Shraddha rituals for ancestors
Moksha beliefs in Hinduism
